questions.prompt: What if a listener declines further contact?

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Demonstrates accurate attention, proportionate warmth, role clarity and respect for refusal without inferring character.
scoring.transfer: Create a two-minute fictional welcome or written equivalent with a clear purpose, an accurate acknowledgment and one optional invitation. Include an alternative where the recipient declines. Review against observable attention, accurate information and respect for choice.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
